title: California's 24th Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 general election for California's 24th Congressional District pits five-term Democratic incumbent Salud Carbajal against Republican challenger Bob Smith. The district covers the Central Coast, including all of Santa Barbara County and portions of San Luis Obispo and Ventura counties, and has a Cook Partisan Voting Index of D+13. Carbajal, first elected in 2016, advanced from the June top-two primary with 54.4% of the vote, while Smith, a retired U.S. Navy commander, secured 36.0% to claim the second general election slot. The race features contrasts between Carbajal's record as a moderate Democrat focused on infrastructure, environment, and veterans' issues versus Smith's platform emphasizing fiscal responsibility, border security, and bipartisan problem-solving. Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solid Democratic.'
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found specifically for the 2026 general election matchup in California's 24th Congressional District. The Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solid D' (D+13 PVI), suggesting a Democratic advantage.

candidates.name: Salud Carbajal
candidates.summary: Salud Carbajal is the five-term incumbent U.S. Representative for California's 24th Congressional District, first elected in 2016. He previously served 12 years on the Santa Barbara County Board of Supervisors and was a Marine Corps Reservist. In Congress, he sits on the Armed Services, Agriculture, and Transportation & Infrastructure Committees, where he is Ranking Member of the Coast Guard and Maritime Transportation Subcommittee.

candidates.name: Bob Smith
candidates.summary: Bob Smith is a retired U.S. Navy Commander and systems engineer running for Congress as a Republican. He served over 26 years on active duty, including multiple combat deployments, and earned the Navy's Best Engineer of the Year award in 2023. Smith holds a B.S. in General Engineering Technology and an M.S. in Systems Engineering, and his campaign emphasizes restoring fiscal responsibility, border security, and bipartisan cooperation.

forecast.rationale: No district-specific general election polling is available, so confidence is constrained and the forecast relies on structural indicators. Those indicators strongly favor Democrats: California's 24th has a D+13 Cook PVI, Democratic incumbent Salud Carbajal is a five-term incumbent, he led the June top-two primary with 54.4% to Bob Smith's 36.0%, and Cook Political Report rates the seat as 'Solid Democratic.' The district's partisan lean, incumbency advantage, and primary result all point to an overwhelming Democratic advantage. Without contrary polling or evidence of unusual volatility, a safe Democratic hold is the appropriate assessment.
